newsitem.title: USA: AMEX, CBOE to trade Spectrian options from Aug 22.
newsitem.headline: AMEX, CBOE to trade Spectrian options from Aug 22.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange and the Chicago Board Options Exchange said Friday they would list options on Spectrian Corp on August 22.
The options will have opening strike prices of 40, 45 and 50, with initial expirations in September, October, November and February.
At the AMEX, where the specialist will be Spear, Leeds & Kellogg, position limits have been set at 4,500 contracts.
Susquehanna Investment Group has been named the designated primary market maker for the options at the CBOE.
